name: arnica montana + comfrey root + onion + tin
purpose: Use: Promotes healing of broken bones.
otcwarn: Warnings: Claims based on traditional homeopathic practice, not accepted medical evidence. Not FDA evaluated. Contains sugar. Diabetics and persons intolerant of sucrose (sugar): Consult a doctor before use. Do not use if allergic to any ingredient.
